description: This Java class defines a custom data type for MySQL databases within Liquibase. It overrides the default boolean type representation to use TINYINT(1) specifically for MySQL, ensuring compatibility with how MySQL handles boolean values. The class extends Liquibase's BooleanType and overrides methods to specify the data type for MySQL databases and adjusts its priority.

classes.name: MySQLBooleanType
classes.description: A custom Liquibase data type class that ensures boolean values are stored as TINYINT(1) in MySQL databases, overriding default representations.

methods.name: toDatabaseDataType
methods.description: Returns the appropriate database data type for boolean values, customized for MySQL to use TINYINT(1).

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of this data type, slightly higher than the default.
